sections.Profile:
The "Surf Champ" pinball machine, manufactured by Gottlieb in 1976, features a vibrant surfing theme designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. This electro-mechanical machine is notable for its wide release, with over 10,000 units produced.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Water Sports, Good Times, Swimming, Sports, Recreation, Surfing, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Gordon Morison
- Design: Ed Krynski
sections.Editions:

- Surf Champ: 10,343 made, released 1976-08-01, model number 386
